Real or AI-generated? Can you tell the difference?

AI can now create images that look very real, making it harder to tell fact from fiction. Deepfakes are also being used in scams, impersonation, and disinformation campaigns.
 
That’s way, this #CyberFriday, our Editor-in-Chief @agasztold@mastodon.world  recommends:
📖 A Comparative Benchmarking Study of Classical Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Image-Based Deepfake Detection by Kushal Zanzari, Jayesh Muley, Sneha Chandravanshi, Anshika Jain, Taufik Hussain, and Ajay Kumar Phulre.

📊 The study compares different methods for detecting fake images generated or manipulated by AI. It shows how machine learning and deep learning can help identify deepfakes and support digital trust.

🗣️As AI-generated content becomes more common, reliable detection tools are becoming increasingly important.
